text:
Sam: hey folks — quick heads up, opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/2142. Small rename + run fmt changes. CI failing on gofmt in two files. tests pass locally. can someone with fmt privileges either approve or suggest quick patch? cc @Maya @Liam
Maya: I can take a look in ~30m. For tiny fmt issues we usually push an autoformat commit instead of requesting a formatter exception. Can you run `gofumpt -w` and force-push?
Sam: yeah running that now. also experimented renaming `RequestID` -> `RequestId` in runtime/trace.go — trying to avoid json tag churn. if that's noisy i can revert.
Liam: fwiw i'd prefer keeping `RequestID` (initialism caps). if only the json tag needs to change, revert the ident change. pinging the style owners.
Code Style Bot: quick reminder — repo convention: keep common initialisms ALL_CAPS (see CONTRIBUTING.md#naming).
Maya: OK let's keep RequestID. Sam, can you revert the ident rename and just update the json tag comment if needed? Then run gofumpt and push.
Sam: reverted the ident rename, pushed a fmt-only commit. kicking CI now.
CI Bot: Build (unit) — passed
CI Bot: Lint — failed: gofumpt differences in pkg/ingest/reader.go (1 file). details: https://ci.internal.redwood/1234
Sam: one more file slipped through, patching that now.
Liam: if you want i can push a tiny autofix and squash for you (i'm on a short window).
Sam: that would be amazing if you have time, otherwise i'll handle in ~15m.
Liam: pushed commit `gofumpt: apply` and rebased/squashed. PTAL @Maya
Maya: LGTM. leaving approval. :white_check_mark:
Sam: thanks! i'll merge in the next merge window unless anyone objects.
Jordan: no objections, queue it. :thumbsup:
Sam: merging now — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
